turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I take my dog on a long hike?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Most healthy adult dogs love it. How old is your dog, and what breed?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. We're finally getting a dog! The kids have been begging for years.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How exciting! Are you leaning toward a puppy, or an older dog from a shelter?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, I need a quick chat with my colleague. Not a word from you till I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Omar, how many chairs did you manage to borrow?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Eleven. Mrs Patel had four, the church hall lent me the rest.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: People can stand. It's a birthday drinks, not a wedding.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grandpa can't stand for two hours, though.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then he gets the armchair. I'll put a cushion on it and a reserved sign, he'll think it's hilarious.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. And the folding table, did that come too?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's in the hallway, but one leg wobbles. Bring some tape.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Finished with that. Your turn to talk.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Any thoughts on the new family dog, puppy or shelter adult?
